name: fix_imports
description: Analyze and fix import-related issues in a file: undefined symbols, circular imports, unused imports. Uses the code-index symbols/refs tables for symbol lookup and import graph. Can provide auto-fix suggestions for missing imports and unused import removal. For circular imports, recommends structural changes (extract shared types).

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory. Call reindex first.

max_candidates.description: Max candidate symbols per undefined symbol (default: 10)
